resources.string: Taps, swipes and types on your behalf

Clickify replays the taps and swipes you set up yourself. It needs this permission because sending a touch to another app is the only thing Android allows an accessibility service to do. It reads nothing from your screen, keeps everything on this device, and has no permission to use the internet.
No scenarios yet. Create one, then place its markers over the app you want to automate.
Saved by a newer version — it can only be deleted
Its steps and its settings go with it. There is no undo.
